mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may potentiate CNS depression effects of clobazam (benzodiazepine analog), and both agents can inhibit metabolism through CYP3A4, leading to increased clobazam levels.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and impaired cognition; consider dose adjustment of clobazam or alternative anticonvulsant if CNS depression is significant.
